vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE1: DATA(... KEYS(10 0) RECORDSIZE(225 225)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

scenarios.name: first-entry-inquire
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the map initialised (customer number '0000000000') and sent ERASE, then the same task's RECEIVE: option 1 inquires customer 1 (LINK LGICUS01 -> LGICDB01); the customer shown, RETURN TRANSID('SSC1') with COMM-AREA

scenarios.name: inquire
scenarios.why: option 1 on a returning task (EIBCALEN > 0: GO TO A-GAIN): customer 7 (no phone numbers)

scenarios.name: inquire-not-found
scenarios.why: option 1 for a customer not on file: LGICDB01 sets CA-RETURN-CODE '01' -> NO-DATA ('No data was returned.'), ERROR-OUT sends the map and initialises the areas

scenarios.name: add
scenarios.why: option 2: LINK LGACUS01 ('01ACUS') adds the customer (GET COUNTER GENACUSTNUM 1000011, INSERT CUSTOMER, LGACVS01's VSAM copy, LGACDB02's CUSTOMER_SECURE row); the postcode upper-cased first; WRITE-GENACNTL finds GENACNTL's HIGH CUSTOMER item and REWRITEs it with the new number; 'New Customer Inserted'

scenarios.name: add-first-customer
scenarios.why: option 2 with no GENACNTL queue: the customer is added, then WRITE-GENACNTL WRITEQs '**** GENAPP CNTL' and then 'LOW CUSTOMER=' FROM(WRITE-MSG-L) X(13) LENGTH(23), past its FROM item: X6, the task judged up to it

scenarios.name: add-fails
scenarios.why: option 2 with LGACDB01's INSERT into CUSTOMER failing (SQLCODE -913): CA-RETURN-CODE '90'; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: update
scenarios.why: option 4: inquire customer 5 (LGICUS01), SEND MAP, RECEIVE MAP again (the harness gives a task one input per map: the second RECEIVE reads the same fields), then LINK LGUCUS01 ('01UCUS') with the fields typed: CUSTOMER updated, LGUCVS01 rewrites the VSAM copy; 'Customer details updated'

scenarios.name: update-not-found
scenarios.why: option 4 for a customer not on file: the inquiry returns '01' -> NO-DATA before any update

scenarios.name: update-fails
scenarios.why: option 4 with LGUCDB01's UPDATE of CUSTOMER failing (SQLCODE -913): CA-RETURN-CODE non-zero; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: update-row-gone
scenarios.why: option 4 with LGUCDB01's UPDATE of CUSTOMER finding no row (SQLCODE +100: the row went between the inquiry and the update): CA-RETURN-CODE '01', no error message; LGUCVS01 still rewrites the VSAM copy; back in LGTESTC1, IF CA-RETURN-CODE > 0 -> NO-UPD 'Error Updating Customer', ERROR-OUT

scenarios.name: bad-option
scenarios.why: option '9': WHEN OTHER -- 'Please enter a valid option', the option field's length -1 (cursor), SEND MAP ... CURSOR

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: HANDLE AID CLEAR(CLEARIT) -- the map sent MAPONLY, RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: HANDLE AID PF3(ENDIT) -- SEND TEXT 'Transaction ended' ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no input: the RECEIVE raises MAPFAIL, HANDLE CONDITION MAPFAIL(ENDIT)

notes: GenApp's customer test transaction (LGTESTC1, transid SSC1, BMS map SSMAPC1 of mapset SSMAP: the symbolic map is generated from base/src/ssmap.bms, @bms/SSMAP.cpy). A first task (EIBCALEN 0) sends the initialised map and RECEIVEs in the same task; a returning one (EIBCALEN > 0; the program has no DFHCOMMAREA, its own COMM-AREA goes back through RETURN TRANSID) goes straight to the RECEIVE. HANDLE AID CLEAR / PF3 and HANDLE CONDITION MAPFAIL are exercised; the option field picks inquire (1: LGICUS01), add (2: LGACUS01, a failure is SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK; a success updates TS queue GENACNTL's HIGH CUSTOMER item, WRITE-GENACNTL) or inquire-then-update (4: LGICUS01, SEND MAP, a second RECEIVE MAP -- the harness gives a task one input per map, so it reads the same fields -- then LGUCUS01). The case runs the whole chain in the task: the three front ends, their Db2 back ends, the VSAM services, LGACDB02 and LGSTSQ (eleven programs). The VSAM file and its data are genapp-lgacus01's; Db2 is db2cre.jcl's tables and rows; the named counter GENACUSTNUM and the queue GENACNTL are stated by the scenarios that add. Judged up to a refused WRITEQ (oracle_assumptions.md X6): WRITE-GENACNTL with no HIGH CUSTOMER item (its second WRITEQ, FROM(WRITE-MSG-L) X(13) LENGTH(23)), and every back-end failure, which LINKs LGSTSQ before it returns. NO-UPD is reached by update-row-gone (LGUCDB01's UPDATE answered +100, which LGUCDB01 returns as '01' without its error logger). Uncovered: IF CA-RETURN-CODE > 0 true after the add LINK, and NO-ADD: every failure of the add chain LINKs LGSTSQ first and the task is judged up to its refused WRITEQ (X6), so what follows is not compared or counted; the plain RETURN after END-EVALUATE, which no WHEN falls through to.
